title: PUR-SUP-01 Supplier Master Create
summary: Ledgerline screen used by authorised purchasing roles to create supplier master records and upload supplier certificates.
body:
Screen PUR-SUP-01 is the Ledgerline screen used to create new supplier master records following written approval from the purchase manager [^r1][^r17]. Upon record creation, Ledgerline automatically assigns the supplier an ACTIVE status without requiring documentation [^r2][^r9][^r18]. It also hosts a Certificates tab for uploading compliance documentation such as [[topic-un-38-3-certificates|UN 38.3]] test reports [^r5][^r10].

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Screen code | PUR-SUP-01 |
| Module | Purchasing |
| Navigation | Masters > Supplier create |
| Write service | sup_create |
| Endpoint | POST /ll72/svc/sup_create |
| Allowed roles | [[role-pur-exec\|PUR-EXEC]], [[role-pur-sr\|PUR-SR]], SYS-ADMIN |

## Fields

PUR-SUP-01 is accessible via the menu path Masters > Supplier create by roles [[role-pur-exec|PUR-EXEC]], [[role-pur-sr|PUR-SR]], and SYS-ADMIN [^r12].

The entry fields on the screen include:
* **Supplier name (`name`)**: Required field containing the supplier's trading name [^r6][^r13].
* **City (`city`)**: Required field indicating the supplier's city [^r6][^r13].
* **Country code (`state`)**: Required two-letter country code [^r6][^r13].
* **VAT number (`vat_no`)**: Optional field entered without spaces [^r4][^r6][^r13]. Duplicate checks only run against this field; leaving it blank bypasses system duplicate detection [^r8][^r15].
* **Payment terms (`pt_cd`)**: Optional field indicating agreed payment terms, which defaults to N30 [^r4][^r6][^r13].
* **Supplier code (`sup_cd`)**: Read-only field automatically generated by Ledgerline upon saving using the initials of the supplier name, the first three letters of the city, and a sequential number [^r7][^r13].

On the Certificates tab, fields include Certificate type (such as UN38.3), Document reference, Valid to date, and an attached scan of the test report [^r5][^r10]. Expired certificates display with a red valid-to date on this tab, though Ledgerline does not block purchase orders for suppliers with expired certificates [^r11].

## Keys and services

* **F8**: Triggers the write service `sup_create` (endpoint `POST /ll72/svc/sup_create`) using the supplier name, city, two-letter country code, VAT number without spaces, and payment terms [^r4][^r14][^r16].
* **Save Certificate**: Executes service `sup_cert_upload` to store the certificate type, document reference, valid-to date, and scanned file [^r5].

## Messages

* **`SUPPLIER <code> CREATED`**: Status bar confirmation returned after service `sup_create` successfully saves the new supplier record [^r4][^r9].
* **`CERT SAVED`**: Status bar message confirming that service `sup_cert_upload` has saved the certificate [^r5][^r10].
* **[[err-sup-0118|ERR-SUP-0118]]**: Error thrown when attempting to register a VAT registration number that already exists in Ledgerline [^r3][^r8][^r15][^r16].

## Versions and conflicts

Under current policy [[pol-sup-003|POL-SUP-003]] v2.3 and [[sop-pur-001|SOP-PUR-001]] v3.1, screen PUR-SUP-01 is used by authorised users once the onboarding file has received written approval from the purchase manager, immediately assigning ACTIVE status upon creation [^r1][^r2][^r17][^r18]. Under superseded policy POL-SUP-003 v2.2 (in [[pol-pur-001|POL-PUR-001]]), creation on PUR-SUP-01 required collecting company registration, VAT certificate, insurance, bank letter, and a signed Code of Conduct prior to creation [^r19][^r20].

r1.loc_text: p. 4, Appendix A. Guidance for proposers
r1.quote: Following approval from the purchase manager, the proposer or authorised user creates the new supplier record in Ledgerline using screen PUR-SUP-01.

r2.loc_text: p. 4, Appendix A. Guidance for proposers
r2.quote: The account is set to active status immediately upon entry.

r3.quote: Ledgerline refuses to create a second supplier with a VAT number that is already registered (ERR-SUP-0118).

r4.quote: Create the supplier on PUR-SUP-01 (service sup_create) with the name, city, two-letter country code, VAT number and payment terms. Ledgerline generates the supplier code and shows SUPPLIER <code> CREATED in the status bar.

r5.quote: Upload the UN 38.3 certificate on the Certificates tab of the supplier (service sup_cert_upload): certificate type UN38.3, the document reference and the valid-to date, with the scanned test report attached. The status bar shows CERT SAVED.

r6.quote: Supplier name*, City*, Country code* (two letters, for example GB, NL), VAT number, Payment terms (F2 lookup; default N30).

r7.quote: The supplier code is generated by Ledgerline on Save from the initials of the name, the first three letters of the city and a running number.

r8.quote: If a VAT number is entered, Ledgerline checks that no other supplier has the same VAT number. If one does, Save fails with ERR-SUP-0118

r9.quote: A new supplier is created ACTIVE. Ledgerline does not hold the supplier back for missing documents; any such check is a company procedure.

r10.quote: Enter Certificate type* (for example UN38.3, ISO-9001), Document reference* and Valid to*. Attach the scanned file. Press F8. The status bar shows CERT SAVED.

r11.quote: It shows the valid-to date in red once it has passed. Ledgerline does not block orders for an expired certificate.

r12.quote: Menu: Masters > Supplier create. Roles: PUR-EXEC, PUR-SR, SYS-ADMIN.

r13.quote: SUP NAME name str Yes CITY city str Yes COUNTRY CD (2) state str Yes

r15.quote: Duplicates are refused only by VAT number (ERR-SUP-0118). A supplier entered without a VAT number is never checked.

r16.quote: Save F8 sup_create Same VAT number already registered ERR-SUP-0118

r17.loc_text: p. 4, Creating the account in Ledgerline
r17.quote: Following approval from the purchase manager, the proposer or authorised user creates the new supplier record in Ledgerline using screen PUR-SUP-01.

r18.loc_text: p. 4, Creating the account in Ledgerline
r18.quote: The account is set to active status immediately upon entry.

r19.quote: Before the supplier is created in Ledgerline (screen PUR-SUP-01), the proposer must collect: the VAT registration certificate

r20.quote: Ledgerline refuses to create a second supplier with a VAT number that is already registered (ERR-SUP-0118). It does not catch a duplicate entered without a VAT number

conflicts.today: Under current policy POL-SUP-003 v2.3 and procedure SOP-PUR-001 v3.1, PUR-SUP-01 is used after written approval from the purchase manager, immediately assigning ACTIVE status.
conflicts.other: Superseded policy POL-SUP-003 v2.2 (in POL-PUR-001) required collection of company registration, VAT certificate, insurance, bank letter, and signed Code of Conduct prior to creation in PUR-SUP-01.
